## M1 Arc 1.0.10

- Fixed the control panel and emergency shortcut becoming unavailable after restarting Cyberpunk with a saved menu shortcut.
- Fixed the same readiness issue when the renderer resets while the panel is closed.

Install over your existing installation with the game closed. Keep settings.json; no shortcut reset or deletion is required if your shortcut has already been migrated.

[Documentation](https://m1nsook.github.io/m1arc/) · [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/cyberpunk2077/mods/39311)
